purpose: v028 rolling idle hang elimination, in-gear engine braking expansion (14/10 mph), overrun pop audition (-4 deg spark / 1.25s delay), and low-throttle cruising stutter diagnostic logging

changes_since_previous_run: Relative to v027: restored positive decay rates in [ECM] 32984 (0.00 -> 0.02-0.05); lowered DFCO enable VSS to 14 mph ([ECM] 44491) and disable VSS to 10 mph ([ECM] 44492); trimmed 2,150 RPM dashpot pre-position air from 0.78 to 0.55 lb/min ([ECM] 32988); extended DFCO delay to 1.25s ([ECM] 44496); retarded warm decel spark to -2 deg at 3k and -4 deg at 4-6k RPM ([ECM] 44605). profile.status: All 18 requested channels required; paired with SCG-1 wideband lambda

conditions.accessories: Standard driving; A/C OFF during pulls

planned_actions: Stage A: Rolling stop idle decay test. Coast down in neutral/clutch-in to 0 mph without throttle blip; verify idle smoothly decays to 950 RPM without hanging at 1,300-1,500 RPM.
Stage B: In-gear 2nd/1st gear engine braking down to 10 mph. Verify DFCO stays active below 18 mph down to 10 mph.
Stage C: Overrun decel pop evaluation. Decel in gear above 3,500 RPM; verify audible, crisp overrun burble during the 1.25s delay window without excessive violence.

Stage D: Low-throttle cruising stutter diagnostic hold. Hold steady light-throttle cruise (35-45 mph, 2,000-2,500 RPM, 2-5% throttle) for 10-15 seconds to capture clean telemetry on MAF volts, STFT, pulse width, and spark advance.
stop_conditions: Wideband lambda > 0.80 (> 11.7 AFR) under boost > 8 psi
Boost spike > 15.0 psi (approaching 16 psi SCG-1 cut)
Engine stall or severe undershoot (< 700 RPM) on clutch-in
Fuel rail pressure collapse (< 35 psi differential)
